# Test Strategy

## 1. Introduction
<!-- Purpose, what is in and out of testing scope, test tool and where test cases live. -->
- **In scope:** {{containers, integrations, NFR categories}}
- **Out of scope:** {{e.g. third-party system internals, customer network}}
- **Test case management:** {{Jira Xray / Zephyr / Azure Test Plans / in code only}}
- **References:** [Scope](../01-requirements/scope.md) · [NFRs](../01-requirements/nfr.md) · [arc42 §7 Deployment View](../02-architecture/arc42/07-deployment-view.md)

## 2. Test Levels & Types
<!-- Keep only the rows that apply. Automated: Yes / Partly / No. Env: where it runs.
     Example row:
| Contract | API matches openapi.yaml; consumers' expectations | Each API container | Dev | Schemathesis / Pact | Yes | CI on every PR |
-->
| Level / type | Purpose | Scope | Responsible | Tools | Automated | When / environment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unit | Logic of a single unit | {{all containers}} | Dev | {{xUnit / Jest / pytest}} | Yes | CI on every PR |
| Integration | Container with its real dependencies (DB, queue) | {{containers}} | Dev | {{Testcontainers}} | Yes | CI on every PR |
| Contract | API / event contracts match the specs | {{API containers}} | Dev | {{tool}} | Yes | CI on every PR |
| End-to-end | Key user journeys across containers | {{UC-NN list}} | QA | {{Playwright / Cypress}} | {{Partly}} | stg, after each deploy |
| Regression | Previously working features still work | {{suite}} | QA | {{tool}} | {{Partly}} | stg, before each release |
| Performance | NFR-PERF / NFR-SCAL targets | {{scenarios}} | QA + SA | {{k6 / JMeter / Azure Load Testing}} | Yes | stg, see §9 |
| Security | Vulnerabilities, misconfiguration | {{all}} | Dev + DevOps | {{SAST / dependency scan / DAST / pen test}} | {{Partly}} | CI + before go-live |
| DR / resilience | Backup restore, failover meet RPO / RTO | {{data stores}} | DevOps | {{manual / chaos tool}} | No | stg, before go-live |
| UAT | Business acceptance | {{scope items}} | Customer (QA supports) | {{tool}} | No | stg, see §11 |

## 5. Quality Gates
<!-- Automatic or manual gates that block progress. Thresholds are project decisions — record them, don't guess. -->
| Gate | Criteria | Enforced at |
|---|---|---|
| Pull request | Build green; unit + integration tests pass; coverage ≥ {{n}} % on changed code; no new critical SAST findings; review approved | PR checks |
| Deploy to stg | {{contract tests pass, image scan: no critical/high vulnerabilities}} | Pipeline |
| Release to prod | {{regression pass, no open Critical/High defects, performance PSR PASS for the release, UAT sign-off}} | Release checklist |

## 6. Entry & Exit Criteria
| Phase | Entry criteria | Exit criteria |
|---|---|---|
| System testing (stg) | {{build deployed, smoke test passed, test data loaded}} | {{all planned tests executed, no open Critical/High defects}} |
| UAT | {{system testing exited, UAT users trained, UAT scripts ready}} | {{customer sign-off}} |
| Go-live | {{UAT signed off, PSR PASS, DR test done, runbook ready}} | {{smoke test in prod passed}} |

## 7. Defect Management
<!-- Severity = technical impact; priority = order of fixing (set by PM with the customer). -->
| Severity | Definition | Example | Target fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| Critical | System unusable or data loss / security breach, no workaround | {{example}} | {{hotfix, within n h}} |
| High | Major function broken, workaround is hard | {{example}} | {{next release / n days}} |
| Medium | Function partly broken, workaround exists | {{example}} | {{planned release}} |
| Low | Cosmetic or minor | {{example}} | {{backlog}} |

- Tracker: {{Jira project / board}}, issue type {{Bug}}, workflow {{Open → In Progress → Ready for Test → Closed}}.
- Investigation: bugs that meet the RCA criteria in CLAUDE.md get a Root Cause Analysis in `docs/07-operations/rca/` (template `_templates/rca.md`).
- Release rule: {{no open Critical or High defects; Medium defects agreed with the customer}}.
